minor.issue: Bogus tier_id path raises HTTPException(502, detail='AffiliateTier not found'). Backend behaviour is correct (readable detail, no stack trace) but Cloudflare/edge REPLACES 5xx bodies with a generic HTML '502 Bad gateway' page, so the readable message never reaches the admin UI. The codebase already handles this pattern for /orders/checkout by returning 400 for SellAuth errors (see server.py L797-800 comment: '4xx so the real reason reaches the buyer: proxies replace 5xx bodies with their own page.'). Recommend applying the same pattern in server.py set_affiliate_tier() — raise 400 instead of 502 so the SellAuth error text ('AffiliateTier not found') is preserved by the edge and shown in the admin toast.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Change set_affiliate_tier() in server.py to raise HTTPException(400) instead of 502 on SellAuthError, matching the /orders/checkout pattern, so Cloudflare doesn't strip the readable error body. Currently a bogus tier_id shows a generic Cloudflare 502 page instead of 'AffiliateTier not found' in the admin toast.
OPTIONAL — Consider adding an aria-live region for the promoters leaderboard toast so screen readers pick up the tier-change confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: admin_affiliates() (server.py L1146) correctly sorts by (earnings, referrals) desc using a tuple key, and correctly does NOT leak MongoDB _id (all fields are explicit).
GOOD: set_affiliate_tier() (server.py L1190) is guarded by Depends(get_admin_user) so non-admin gets 403, unauth gets 401 — verified by tests.

GOOD: AffiliatesTab.jsx uses api.put with tier_id as query param (not body), matching the FastAPI signature `set_affiliate_tier(customer_id: int, tier_id: int, admin=...)` where tier_id is a query param — verified working end-to-end (toast success).

GOOD: ShareButtons.copyCaption() wraps navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch and toasts 'Copy blocked by your browser — copy the link above manually' on rejection — panel does NOT crash in sandboxed/embed contexts. This is the fix flagged in iteration 21.
GOOD: ReferEarn.copy() also wraps writeText in try/catch (iter21 finding fixed).

MINOR: X share opens `twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=...` (Twitter itself 301s to x.com/intent/tweet). Both hostnames resolve to the same intent page — no action needed, but if you want to future-proof, switch to `x.com/intent/tweet` directly to avoid the redirect.
MINOR (carried from iter21): server.py has grown to 1836+ lines. The affiliate block (~150 lines) plus the new admin_affiliates block are a clean extraction candidate to /app/backend/affiliate.py.
SECURITY: verified that PUT /admin/affiliates/{cid}/tier is called with customer_id from the URL path only — no way for a non-admin to elevate; the admin dependency chain enforces it.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — the two new endpoints and both UI surfaces (AffiliatesTab, ShareButtons) work as specified. The single minor gap is the Cloudflare-502-body-rewrite affecting the bogus-tier-id error path; root cause is server.py raising 502 for upstream SellAuth failure while the codebase's own convention (see /orders/checkout) is to use 400 precisely to survive proxy body-rewriting.
